intro_html: Ground turkey does the volume, a little chorizo does the flavor, and cream cheese ties it all into a silky sauce over shells with zucchini and blistered cherry tomatoes. Each bowl serves up 42 grams of protein at 736 calories for about $2.52. The chorizo-to-turkey ratio is the money move here.
cost_closing_html: About $2.52 a bowl for a creamy sausage pasta that an Italian-ish bistro would price at $15 or more. Using chorizo as a seasoning instead of the main meat is what keeps the whole batch under $36.
shop_smart: Three quarters of a pound of chorizo at $1.81 seasons three full pounds of turkey. Buying flavor in small amounts and volume in lean meat is one of the best tricks in budget cooking.
Cherry tomatoes are the splurge line at $6.86. If they are not on sale, a can of diced tomatoes gets you most of the way there for a third of the price.
Two bricks of store-brand 1/3 fat cream cheese make the sauce for $2.20. A jar of alfredo covering this much pasta would run over $6.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Boil the pasta shells 1 minute short of package time. Before draining, scoop out and save about 3 cups of the starchy pasta water.

Brown the chorizo in a splash of oil in your big pot, breaking it up, then add the ground turkey and cook until no pink remains, seasoning with the Italian seasoning, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the diced zucchini and cook 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook 3 to 4 minutes until they blister and start to break down.
Drop the cream cheese in chunks and stir with a ladle of the reserved pasta water until it melts into a smooth sauce. Add more pasta water until it is silky.
Fold in the drained shells, lemon juice, parmesan, and basil, tossing until every shell is coated.
Portion into 14 containers while the sauce is still loose; it thickens as it cools.
portion_html: Weigh the full pot, subtract the empty pot weight you wrote down, and divide by 14. Scale that into each container. Every bowl lands at about 736 calories with 42 grams of protein.

recipeIngredient: 1.4 lemons worth of lemon juice (66 g)
steps: Boil the shells just short of done and reserve 3 cups pasta water.
Brown chorizo, then the seasoned ground turkey until no pink remains.
Cook zucchini until tender, then blister the cherry tomatoes.
Melt in cream cheese with pasta water to make a silky sauce.
Fold in shells, lemon juice, parmesan, and basil, then portion into 14 containers.
